bePawsitive.heroCopy: Be Pawsitive is a Siargao-based animal welfare organisation dedicated to spaying, neutering, and vaccinating street animals across the island. Every rental booked with Lola's helps fund their life-changing work.
bePawsitive.aboutBody1: Be Pawsitive is a SEC-registered animal welfare organisation based on Siargao Island. Founded on a simple belief — that every stray animal deserves love, care, and a healthy life — the organisation runs spay, neuter, and vaccination programmes across the island.
bePawsitive.aboutQuote: "Every animal spayed or neutered prevents hundreds of future strays from entering the cycle."
bePawsitive.aboutBody2: Lola's Rentals has been a proud sponsor since the beginning. It's why Lola herself — our rescue, now pampered pooch — is at the heart of everything we do. Every vehicle in our fleet is named after an animal that's been through the programme.
bePawsitive.progSpayDesc: Free surgical procedures for stray and community-owned animals across the island.
bePawsitive.progVaxDesc: Core vaccines administered at outreach events in Santa Fe, Dapa, and surrounding barangays.
bePawsitive.progCommunityDesc: Education and awareness programmes helping communities care for animals responsibly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Body: Lola's Rentals is a scooter and vehicle rental service based in Siargao, Philippines. We also run the Paw Card loyalty programme. This policy explains how we handle the personal information you share with us when you make a booking or join the Paw Card programme.
privacy.sec2Intro: When you book a vehicle or sign up for a Paw Card, we collect:
privacy.sec2Item5: Booking details (dates, vehicle, add-ons, transfer preferences)
privacy.sec2Item6: Flight information (if you request an airport transfer)
privacy.sec2Footer: We do not collect payment card numbers directly. Payments are processed through third-party providers who handle card data under their own security policies.
privacy.sec3Item1: To confirm and manage your vehicle booking
privacy.sec3Item2: To arrange airport or accommodation transfers
privacy.sec3Item3: To operate the Paw Card loyalty programme (tracking stamps and rewards)
privacy.sec3Item4: To contact you about your rental (pickup reminders, extensions, returns)
privacy.sec3Item5: To improve our service based on booking patterns
privacy.sec3Footer: We will never sell your personal information to third parties or send you marketing emails unless you have specifically opted in.
privacy.sec4Body1: We retain your booking information for up to 12 months after your rental ends. This lets us handle any follow-up queries, process security deposit refunds, and maintain your Paw Card stamp history. After 12 months, personal data is anonymised or deleted.
privacy.sec4Body2: Paw Card members' information is kept for as long as the account is active. If you haven't used your Paw Card for 24 months, we'll reach out before removing your account.
privacy.sec5Intro: Your information is only accessible to the Lola's Rentals team who need it to manage your booking. We do not share it with other businesses, except:
privacy.sec5Item2: Transfer drivers (name and pickup details only, for airport transfers)
privacy.sec6Intro: You can ask us at any time to:
privacy.sec6Item1: See what personal information we hold about you
privacy.sec6Item2: Correct any details that are wrong
privacy.sec6Item3: Delete your data (subject to any active booking obligations)
privacy.sec6Item4: Get a copy of your data in a portable format
privacy.sec6Item5: Lodge a complaint with the National Privacy Commission of the Philippines (privacy.gov.ph) if you believe your personal data has been mishandled
privacy.sec7Intro: If you have any questions about your data or want to exercise your rights, get in touch:
privacy.sec8Body: Some fleet vehicles may be equipped with GPS or location-tracking devices for fleet management and security purposes. Location data collected through these devices is used solely for operational purposes and is not shared with third parties.
privacy.sec9Intro: We use the following sub-processors to operate our service. Each processes personal data only as necessary to provide their respective service:
privacy.sec10Body: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in the United States by the third-party processors listed above. The Philippines National Privacy Commission (NPC) has not issued an adequacy finding for the United States. Data transfers to these processors are made on the basis of contractual necessity — to perform the booking contract you have entered into with us — and your consent to this Privacy Policy when using our service.
privacy.sec11Intro: We process your personal data on the following legal grounds:
privacy.sec11Item1: Booking and rental data is processed on the basis of contractual performance (Republic Act 10173 / Data Privacy Act 2012; GDPR Article 6(1)(b))
privacy.sec11Item2: Safety, waiver, and incident data is processed on the basis of legitimate interest and legal obligation
privacy.sec11Item3: Marketing communications are only sent where you have given separate, specific opt-in consent

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Returns Policy
refundPolicy.sec1Body: Lola's Rentals operates a strict no-refund policy on early returns, regardless of notice given. We make exceptions only in the following circumstances:
refundPolicy.sec1Item1: Medical emergency — a doctor's note or hospital documentation is required
refundPolicy.sec1Item2: Unforeseen flight change — official written confirmation from the airline is required, and at least 24 hours notice of your new return time must be given
refundPolicy.sec1Footer: If a refund is approved and your shortened rental falls into a lower pricing bracket, your total will be recalculated accordingly. Card convenience fees (5%) are non-refundable in all circumstances.
refundPolicy.sec2Body: In the unlikely event your vehicle develops a fault during your rental, we will work as quickly as possible to resolve the issue:
refundPolicy.sec2Item1: If a replacement vehicle is available, we will swap it during operational hours
refundPolicy.sec2Item2: If no replacement is available, our team will carry out on-site repairs
refundPolicy.sec2Item3: If repairs exceed 3 hours during operational hours, compensation will be considered
refundPolicy.sec2Item4: Faults reported outside operational hours will be addressed within 3 hours of our next opening time
refundPolicy.sec3Body: Bookings cancelled before the rental period begins are non-refundable. We recommend purchasing travel insurance that covers trip cancellations and vehicle rental.
refundPolicy.sec4Body: If you have any questions about this policy, please reach out to our team via
refundPolicy.sec4BodySuffix: or visit us in store in General Luna, Siargao Island.
